title: ZEBRAARENA: A Diagnostic Simulation Environment for Studying Reasoning-Action Coupling in Tool-Augmented LLMs
authors_zh: Wanjia Zhao, Ludwig Schmidt, James Zou, Vidhisha Balachandran, Lingjiao Chen
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** A procedurally generated Zebra tool environment with unique solutions and optimal query counts for reasoning–action coupling.
程序生成的 Zebra 工具环境，用唯一解和最优查询数测推理—行动耦合。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
When a tool agent fails, real environments often combine missing knowledge, interface noise, and dynamic state, making it hard to attribute errors to internal reasoning or external information acquisition. Public static data may also be memorized, obscuring the relationship between tool-call volume and reasoning quality.

ZebraArena creates a knowledge-minimal environment from procedurally generated Zebra logic puzzles. Critical facts are hidden behind tools, while unique solutions and theoretical minimum query counts enable controlled study of reasoning–action coupling.

工具 agent 失败时，真实环境往往同时包含知识缺口、界面噪声和动态状态，很难判断问题来自内部推理还是外部信息获取。公开静态数据还可能被模型记忆，使工具调用数量与推理质量的关系无法受控分析。

ZebraArena 以程序生成的 Zebra 逻辑谜题建立知识最小化环境，把解题所需的关键信息隐藏在工具中，并提供唯一解和理论最少查询数，用于单独研究推理—行动耦合。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ZebraArena tasks are parameterized by puzzle size, number of missing clues, and the distribution of information across tools; the official data is organized by these configurations and supports further procedural generation. Each task contains constraints, facts available only through targeted calls, a unique canonical solution, and a theoretical optimal query count. Evaluation records final accuracy, call count, overhead relative to optimum, and performance under budgets. It is an extensible simulation environment rather than one fixed-size QA table.
ZebraArena 的任务由谜题规模、缺失线索数量和工具信息分布参数化，官方数据按这些配置发布，可继续程序生成新实例。每题包含约束线索、只可通过定向调用获得的事实、唯一标准解和理论最优查询数。评测同时记录最终准确率、工具调用数量、相对最优开销及受预算限制时的表现；它是可扩展 simulation environment，而不是固定规模的单一问答表。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Generate a logical world: A program samples entities, attributes, and bijective relations, constructs a Zebra puzzle with a unique solution, and checks consistency with a solver.
  1. Hide critical information: Some facts are removed from the visible clues and assigned to queryable tools, forcing the agent to acquire sufficient information through actions.
  1. Compute an optimal baseline: Theoretical minimum query counts are derived from missing facts and constraint structure, providing a model-independent efficiency reference.
  1. Run controlled evaluation: Puzzle size, missing clues, and query budgets are varied while answers, call sequences, and overhead relative to optimum are logged to distinguish reasoning errors from insufficient acquisition.

1. 生成逻辑世界： 程序采样实体、属性和双射关系，构造具有唯一解的 Zebra puzzle，并用求解器检查一致性。
  1. 隐藏关键信息： 从完整线索中移除部分事实，将其分配给可查询工具，使 agent 必须通过行动获得足够信息。
  1. 计算最优基线： 根据缺失事实和约束结构求出理论最少查询数，为工具效率提供与模型无关的参照。
  1. 运行受控评测： 改变谜题规模、缺失数和查询预算，记录答案、调用序列及相对最优开销，区分推理错误与信息收集不足。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On hard instances, GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro reach only about 60% accuracy. Even when correct, GPT-5 uses 70–270% more tool calls than the theoretical optimum, indicating that frontier models often compensate for weak reasoning or information selection through over-querying. Programmatically guaranteed unique solutions and optimal-query baselines support both accuracy and efficiency claims, although synthetic logic puzzles do not represent the semantic complexity of real tools.
在困难实例上，GPT-5 与 Gemini 2.5 Pro 的准确率仍仅约 60%。即使回答正确，GPT-5 的工具调用量也比理论最优多 70%–270%，说明 frontier model 往往通过过度查询弥补推理或信息选择不足。由于每题由程序保证唯一解且存在最优查询基线，该证据能同时支持准确性和效率判断；但合成逻辑谜题不代表真实工具的语义复杂度。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing tool benchmarks mainly report final success or cannot determine how many calls should be necessary. ZebraArena models external actions as acquiring missing facts and provides a unique solution and theoretical query lower bound for each instance; procedural generation also reduces memorization and contamination. The novelty is a controlled reasoning–action experiment and efficiency oracle, not a new agent model.
已有工具 benchmark 主要报告最终成功率，或无法知道最少应调用多少次。ZebraArena 的变化是把外部行动建模为“购买缺失事实”，并为每个实例给出唯一解与理论查询下界；程序生成还降低了知识记忆和污染影响。新意在可控推理—行动实验设计和效率 oracle，而非新的 agent 模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Ecological realism: Zebra-puzzle tools return short deterministic facts and omit permissions, failures, and open semantics. Results do not directly transfer to web or enterprise APIs.
  1. Optimal-query assumption: The lower bound uses known generation structure and ignores the cost of parsing tool documentation. Cross-system comparisons should also report tokens and latency.
  1. Strategy adaptation: If training contains the same generator, models may learn structural shortcuts. Training and evaluation need strict separation by configuration and random seed.

1. 生态真实性： Zebra puzzle 的工具返回短且确定，没有权限、错误和开放语义；结果不能直接外推到网页或企业 API。
  1. 最优查询假设： 理论下界基于已知生成结构，未考虑模型解析工具文档的成本；跨系统比较还应报告 token 与延迟。
  1. 策略适应： 若训练数据包含同一生成器，模型可能学习结构捷径；训练和评测应按配置与随机种子严格隔离。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Reasoning–action diagnosis: At fixed puzzle difficulty, compare accuracy and calls relative to optimum to determine whether gains come from reasoning or extra querying.
  1. Budgeted RL: Combine answer rewards with call costs to train agents to choose the most informative tools under limited budgets.
  1. Planning ablations: Provide all facts, hidden facts, or recovery hints separately to measure reasoning-only, action-only, and coupled conditions.

1. 推理—行动诊断： 在固定谜题难度下比较模型准确率和相对最优调用数，判断改进来自更强推理还是更多查询。
  1. 预算型 RL： 将答对奖励与调用成本组合，训练 agent 在有限查询预算下选择最有信息量的工具。
  1. 规划消融： 分别提供全部事实、隐藏事实或恢复提示，测量 reasoning-only、action-only 与耦合条件的差距。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: A procedurally generated Zebra tool environment with unique solutions and optimal query counts for reasoning–action coupling.
  1. Method hook: Hiding necessary facts behind tools creates an interpretable acquisition–reasoning trade-off.
  1. Data hook: Data is released by puzzle-size and missing-clue configurations and can be generated continuously, so one static total is insufficient.
  1. Evidence anchor: Hard accuracy is about 60%, while GPT-5 still uses 70–270% more calls than optimum.
  1. Reuse decision: It suits controlled efficiency research after isolating generators and adding token and latency costs.

1. 一句话定位： 程序生成的 Zebra 工具环境，用唯一解和最优查询数测推理—行动耦合。
  1. 方法抓手： 将解题必要事实隐藏到工具中，才会形成可解释的查询—推理权衡。
  1. 数据抓手： 数据按谜题规模和缺失线索配置发布，可持续生成，不应只报一个静态总数。
  1. 证据锚点： 困难题准确率约 60%，GPT-5 调用数仍高于最优 70%–270%。
  1. 复用决定： 适合受控效率研究；复用时应隔离生成器并补充 token、延迟成本。
